node.title: THE WEDGE: 0.00707 grid steps at rate 1/8 from any fourth mechanism
node.statement: Recover >= 0.00707 grid steps (~0.9 bits) at rate 1/8 from ANY mechanism outside the three-eater partition — (a) cap-end sharpening, (b) tau* reserve tightening, (c) census crossing pinning. ONE suffices (gate: any). Closing this closes the campaign's first full determination corridor; failing all three lands rate 1/8 bracket-grade honestly.
node.attack_surface: the three alt routes; (b) is likely cheapest (pure re-derivation), (c) is compute-shaped, (a) is proof-shaped
node.falsifier: all three mechanisms exactly computed below the wedge
node.notes: PROVED (Pro Brief C, my 11/11 exact replay + real tex citation): route (a) — the quotient-remainder floor at c = 2^28 delivers 0.0625 steps, 8.8x the wedge. THE RATE-1/8 CORRIDOR'S LEDGER ROW CLOSES. | GATE NORMALIZED ON CLOSE (2026-07-06, minimality law): the delivering route (cap_end_sharpening) is now a req edge; reserve routes (taustar_reserve_tightening, census_crossing_pinning) demoted to ev -- re-promotable if the winner is ever falsified.
